versification: R. H. Charles source numbering normalized to logical chapters 1-108 and contiguous integer verses; lettered subverses and parallel E/G^g readings are preserved in merged text/source_parts

verses.text_en: In those days the Lord bade (them) to summon and testify to the children of earth concerning their wisdom: Show (it) unto them; for ye are their guides, and a recompense over the whole earth.
verses.text_hr: U one dane Gospodin im zapovjedi da pozovu djecu zemlje i posvjedoče im o njihovoj mudrosti: ‘Pokažite im je, jer vi ste njihovi vodiči i nagrada po svoj zemlji.

verses.text_en: For I and My Son will be united with them for ever in the paths of uprightness in their lives; and ye shall have peace: rejoice, ye children of uprightness. Amen.
verses.text_hr: Jer Ja i Moj Sin bit ćemo ujedinjeni s njima zauvijek na stazama čestitosti u njihovim životima; i imat ćete mir: radujte se, sinovi poštenja. Amen.
